clear_payload.description: Remove the entire payload of the selected points, keeping their vectors. Select the points by id or by filter.
clear_payload.display_str_template: Clear the payload of points in the Qdrant collection '{0}'.
clear_payload.name: clear_payload

parameters.description: The collection to work in.
parameters.name: collection

parameters.description: The ids of the points to act on, each a whole number or a UUID. Leave this empty to select points with a Filter instead.
parameters.name: ids

parameters.description: A Qdrant filter over the points' payloads, for example {"must": [{"key": "category", "match": {"value": "kitchen"}}]}. Every payload key a filter names must have a payload index - run 'Create payload index' on it once first.
parameters.name: filter

collection_exists.description: Check whether a collection exists. Answers true or false rather than failing, so a workflow can branch on it before creating or writing.
collection_exists.display_str_template: Check whether the Qdrant collection '{0}' exists.
collection_exists.name: collection_exists

parameters.description: The collection name to check for.
parameters.name: collection

count_points.description: Count the points in a collection, or just the ones matching a filter.
count_points.display_str_template: Count the points in the Qdrant collection '{0}'.
count_points.name: count_points

parameters.description: The collection to work in.
parameters.name: collection

parameters.description: A Qdrant filter over the points' payloads, for example {"must": [{"key": "category", "match": {"value": "kitchen"}}]}. Every payload key a filter names must have a payload index - run 'Create payload index' on it once first.
parameters.name: filter

parameters.description: On by default. Turn it off for a fast estimate on a very large collection.
parameters.name: exact

create_alias.description: Point an alias at a collection. Steps that name the alias follow it, so rebuilding a collection under a new name and re-pointing the alias swaps them over with no downtime. An alias that already points elsewhere is re-pointed.
create_alias.display_str_template: Point the Qdrant alias '{1}' at the collection '{0}'.
create_alias.name: create_alias

parameters.description: The collection to work in.
parameters.name: collection

parameters.description: The alias name, for example 'products-live'.
parameters.name: alias_name

create_collection.description: Create a collection to hold vectors. Vector size must match the embedding model you will store (for example 1536 for OpenAI text-embedding-3-small, 384 for all-MiniLM-L6-v2), and cannot be changed afterwards.
create_collection.name: create_collection

parameters.description: Name for the new collection (for example 'product-descriptions'). Creating a collection that already exists fails - use 'Collection exists' first if you are not sure.
parameters.name: collection

parameters.description: How many numbers each vector has - the dimension of your embedding model.
parameters.name: vector_size

parameters.description: How similarity between two vectors is measured. Cosine is the usual choice for text embeddings.
parameters.name: distance

options.label: Cosine - the usual choice for text embeddings
Dot product - for embeddings that are already normalised
Euclidean - straight-line distance
Manhattan - sum of the per-axis distances

parameters.description: Leave blank for an ordinary collection. Set a name only if each point will hold several different vectors - every later step then has to name which one it means.
parameters.name: vector_name

parameters.description: How each number is stored. float32 is full precision and the default; the smaller types trade a little accuracy for memory.
parameters.name: datatype

options.label: float32 - full precision, the default
float16 - half the memory, slightly less precise
uint8 - a quarter of the memory, for quantised vectors

parameters.description: Store vectors on disk instead of in memory. Slower to search, but lets a small cluster hold more.
parameters.name: on_disk

create_payload_index.description: Index a payload key so points can be filtered and ordered by it. Qdrant Cloud refuses filters on unindexed keys, so run this once for every key your filters use.
create_payload_index.display_str_template: Index the payload key '{1}' in the Qdrant collection '{0}'.
create_payload_index.name: create_payload_index

parameters.description: The collection to work in.
parameters.name: collection

parameters.description: The payload key to index, for example 'category'. A key inside a nested object is written with dots, like 'meta.author'.
parameters.name: field_name

parameters.description: What kind of values this payload key holds.
parameters.name: field_schema

options.label: Keyword - exact matches on a string
Integer - whole numbers, and ranges over them
Float - decimal numbers, and ranges over them
Boolean - true/false
Datetime - timestamps, and ranges over them
Text - full-text search inside a string
UUID - exact matches on a UUID string
Geo - latitude/longitude, for radius and box filters

delete_alias.description: Remove an alias. The collection it pointed at is untouched.
delete_alias.name: delete_alias

parameters.description: The alias name, for example 'products-live'.
parameters.name: alias_name

delete_collection.description: Delete a collection with every point in it, and every alias pointing at it. This cannot be undone.
delete_collection.name: delete_collection

parameters.description: The collection to work in.
parameters.name: collection

delete_payload.description: Remove named keys from the payload of the selected points, keeping the rest of the payload and the vectors.
delete_payload.display_str_template: Delete payload keys from points in the Qdrant collection '{0}'.
delete_payload.name: delete_payload

parameters.description: The collection to work in.
parameters.name: collection

parameters.description: The payload keys to remove from each point.
parameters.name: keys

parameters.description: The ids of the points to act on, each a whole number or a UUID. Leave this empty to select points with a Filter instead.
parameters.name: ids

parameters.description: A Qdrant filter over the points' payloads, for example {"must": [{"key": "category", "match": {"value": "kitchen"}}]}. Every payload key a filter names must have a payload index - run 'Create payload index' on it once first.
parameters.name: filter

delete_payload_index.description: Drop the index on a payload key. The payload itself is left alone, but filters on that key stop working.
delete_payload_index.display_str_template: Drop the payload index on '{1}' in the Qdrant collection '{0}'.
delete_payload_index.name: delete_payload_index

parameters.description: The collection to work in.
parameters.name: collection

parameters.description: The payload key to index, for example 'category'. A key inside a nested object is written with dots, like 'meta.author'.
parameters.name: field_name

delete_points.description: Delete points from a collection, either by id or by filter. Give one or the other, not both.
delete_points.display_str_template: Delete points from the Qdrant collection '{0}'.
delete_points.name: delete_points

parameters.description: The collection to work in.
parameters.name: collection

parameters.description: The ids of the points to act on, each a whole number or a UUID. Leave this empty to select points with a Filter instead.
parameters.name: ids

parameters.description: A Qdrant filter over the points' payloads, for example {"must": [{"key": "category", "match": {"value": "kitchen"}}]}. Every payload key a filter names must have a payload index - run 'Create payload index' on it once first.
parameters.name: filter

get_collection.description: Read one collection's status, how many points it holds, its vector configuration, and which payload keys are indexed (the keys a filter is allowed to use).
get_collection.name: get_collection

parameters.description: The collection to work in.
parameters.name: collection

get_points.description: Fetch points by id. Ids the collection does not hold come back under 'missing_ids' rather than failing the step.
get_points.display_str_template: Get points from the Qdrant collection '{0}'.
get_points.name: get_points

parameters.description: The collection to work in.
parameters.name: collection

parameters.description: The ids of the points to act on. Each id is a whole number or a UUID - Qdrant accepts nothing else.
parameters.name: ids

parameters.description: Return each point's stored payload alongside it.
parameters.name: with_payload

parameters.description: Return each point's vector as well. Off by default: vectors are large and a workflow rarely reads them back.
parameters.name: with_vector

list_collection_aliases.description: List the aliases pointing at one collection.
list_collection_aliases.display_str_template: List the aliases of the Qdrant collection '{0}'.
list_collection_aliases.name: list_collection_aliases

parameters.description: The collection to work in.
parameters.name: collection

list_collections.description: List every collection on the Qdrant cluster. Qdrant reports only their names here; use 'Get collection' for the size and configuration of one.
list_collections.name: list_collections

query_points.description: Search a collection: for the points nearest a vector, nearest a point already stored, or most like a set of examples. Fill in one of the three - leaving all three blank returns points matching the filter in the collection's own order.
query_points.name: query_points

parameters.description: The collection to work in.
parameters.name: collection

parameters.description: The vector to find neighbours of - usually the embedding of the text being searched for. As wide as the collection was created.
parameters.name: query_vector

parameters.description: Instead of a vector: the id of a point already in the collection, to find the points most like it.
parameters.name: query_point_id

parameters.description: Instead of a vector: point ids (or vectors) the results should resemble.
parameters.name: recommend_positive

parameters.description: Point ids (or vectors) the results should avoid resembling. Only used with 'More like these'.
parameters.name: recommend_negative

parameters.description: How the examples are combined. Only used with 'More like these'.
parameters.name: recommend_strategy

options.label: Average vector - the classic recommendation
Best score - favours points close to any one example
Sum of scores - favours points close to several examples

parameters.description: Only for a collection created with named vectors: which vector to search.
parameters.name: using

parameters.description: A Qdrant filter over the points' payloads, for example {"must": [{"key": "category", "match": {"value": "kitchen"}}]}. Every payload key a filter names must have a payload index - run 'Create payload index' on it once first.
parameters.name: filter

parameters.description: How many matches to return.
parameters.name: limit

parameters.description: Optional. Drop matches scoring below this. What counts as a good score depends on the collection's distance metric.
parameters.name: score_threshold

parameters.description: Return each point's stored payload alongside it.
parameters.name: with_payload

parameters.description: Return each point's vector as well. Off by default: vectors are large and a workflow rarely reads them back.
parameters.name: with_vector

scroll_points.description: Page through a collection's points without searching. Feed 'next_page_offset' from one run into 'Start after' on the next to get the following page.
scroll_points.display_str_template: Scroll points in the Qdrant collection '{0}'.
scroll_points.name: scroll_points

parameters.description: The collection to work in.
parameters.name: collection

parameters.description: How many points to return in this page.
parameters.name: limit

parameters.description: The 'next_page_offset' from the previous run. Leave blank for the first page.
parameters.name: offset

parameters.description: A Qdrant filter over the points' payloads, for example {"must": [{"key": "category", "match": {"value": "kitchen"}}]}. Every payload key a filter names must have a payload index - run 'Create payload index' on it once first.
parameters.name: filter

parameters.description: Return each point's stored payload alongside it.
parameters.name: with_payload

parameters.description: Return each point's vector as well. Off by default: vectors are large and a workflow rarely reads them back.
parameters.name: with_vector

parameters.description: Optional. Return the points in the order of this payload key. The key needs a payload index.
parameters.name: order_by_key

parameters.description: Which way round to order. Only used with a key.
parameters.name: order_by_direction

options.label: Ascending - smallest first
Descending - largest first

set_payload.description: Merge keys into the payload of the selected points. Keys you do not name are left as they are. Select the points by id or by filter, not both.
set_payload.display_str_template: Set payload on points in the Qdrant collection '{0}'.
set_payload.name: set_payload

parameters.description: The collection to work in.
parameters.name: collection

parameters.description: The keys and values to set, for example category: 'kitchen', in_stock: true.
parameters.name: payload

parameters.description: The ids of the points to act on, each a whole number or a UUID. Leave this empty to select points with a Filter instead.
parameters.name: ids

parameters.description: A Qdrant filter over the points' payloads, for example {"must": [{"key": "category", "match": {"value": "kitchen"}}]}. Every payload key a filter names must have a payload index - run 'Create payload index' on it once first.
parameters.name: filter

parameters.description: Optional. Set these values inside an existing payload key instead of at the top level.
parameters.name: key

update_vectors.description: Replace the vectors of points that already exist, leaving their payloads untouched. Unlike 'Upsert points' this never creates a point.
update_vectors.display_str_template: Update vectors in the Qdrant collection '{0}'.
update_vectors.name: update_vectors

parameters.description: The collection to work in.
parameters.name: collection

parameters.description: The points to re-embed, each {"id": ..., "vector": [...]}. Payloads are left as they are.
parameters.name: points

upsert_points.description: Add points to a collection, or overwrite points that are already there. Each point is an id (a whole number or a UUID), a vector, and an optional payload of anything you want to store or filter on.
upsert_points.display_str_template: Upsert points into the Qdrant collection '{0}'.
upsert_points.name: upsert_points

parameters.description: The collection to work in.
parameters.name: collection

parameters.description: The points to write, each {"id": ..., "vector": [...], "payload": {...}}. The vector is a list of numbers, as wide as the collection was created; for a collection with named vectors, send an object like {"embedding": [...]} instead.
parameters.name: points

parameters.description: Leave blank to overwrite existing points, which is Qdrant's default. Needs Qdrant 1.19 or newer.
parameters.name: update_mode

options.label: Upsert - insert new points and overwrite existing ones
Insert only - leave a point that already exists alone
Update only - change existing points, insert nothing

description: Store embeddings in Qdrant and search them: manage collections, upsert points with payloads, filter, and run vector and recommendation searches.
